skimOutlines.windowSummary: Top of the booking success/detail page view: imports, schemas, a brand-color hook, and the start of the main Success component that derives booking state, handles feedback/rating mutations, and renders the success page header.

declarations.name: stringToBoolean
declarations.role: Zod helper that coerces an optional string query value into a boolean by checking for the literal "true".

declarations.name: querySchema
declarations.role: Zod schema describing and validating the URL/search-param shape consumed by the Success page (uid, cancel, reschedule, rating, noShow, etc.).

declarations.name: useBrandColors
declarations.role: Hook-like helper that resolves profile brand colors and applies them via useCalcomTheme for the booking success page.

declarations.name: Success
declarations.role: Default-exported page component that computes derived booking state (cancelled/rescheduled/needs-confirmation/past), wires tRPC mutations for rating and host no-show, computes the success-page headline/title, and starts rendering the success card UI.

skimOutlines.windowSummary: Mid-section JSX of the BookingsSingleView component rendering booking details (reason, what, when, who, where), payment, reschedule info, additional notes, UTM params, booking field responses, reschedule/cancel actions, and add-to-calendar links.
Tail end of the booking detail view component plus several helper components: RescheduledToLink, DisplayLocation, and RecurringBookings (with its RecurringBookingsProps type).

declarations.name: RescheduledToLink
declarations.role: Inline link component shown when the current booking was rescheduled to a later one.

declarations.name: DisplayLocation
declarations.role: Renders the booking location either as an external link (when URL) or plain text.

declarations.name: RecurringBookingsProps
declarations.role: Prop type for the RecurringBookings helper component.

declarations.name: RecurringBookings
declarations.role: Lists the upcoming/remaining occurrences of a recurring booking with a collapsible for overflow.
